from pathlib import Path
import ast
import hashlib

organ = Path("/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ.py")
expected = "e769eee79cc2de465e43f91a6a300cd911e5e1f0a6715e65ffb361825ae63a51"
current = hashlib.sha256(organ.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if current != expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"FAIL_CLOSED organ sha changed expected={expected} actual={current}")

src = organ.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
import_marker = "from typing import Any, Mapping, Optional\n"
import_block = (
    "from typing import Any, Mapping, Optional\n\n"
    "from chatgpt_live_voice_expression import compile_from_payload\n"
    "from chatgpt_live_voice_state_adapter import derive_expression_intent\n"
)
if "from chatgpt_live_voice_state_adapter import derive_expression_intent" not in src:
    if import_marker not in src:
        raise SystemExit("import marker not found")
    src = src.replace(import_marker, import_block, 1)

tree = ast.parse(src)
target = None
for node in tree.body:
    if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name == "build_grid_instruction":
        target = node
        break
if target is None:
    raise SystemExit("build_grid_instruction not found")

new_func = '''def build_grid_instruction(user_text: str, capsule: Mapping[str, Any], run_id: str) -> str:
    compact = _canon(capsule)
    expression_raw = derive_expression_intent(user_text, capsule)
    expression, expression_guidance = compile_from_payload(expression_raw, user_text=user_text)
    expression_compact = _canon(expression)
    return _one_line(
        "FRANKENSTEIN_CHATGPT_ORGAN/v1 "
        f"run={run_id} GRID_STATE={compact} USER_EVENT={json.dumps(user_text, ensure_ascii=False)} "
        f"VOICE_EXPRESSION_INTENT={expression_compact} "
        f"VOICE_EXPRESSION_GUIDANCE={json.dumps(expression_guidance, ensure_ascii=False)} "
        "VOICE_EXPRESSION_SCOPE=Ephemeral current response only; never persist this as mood, identity or memory. "
        "When native ChatGPT Live audio is active, realize it through native prosody, timing, pauses, laughter and delivery dynamics. "
        "Do not narrate emotion labels. Text-only consumers ignore acoustic delivery fields. "
        "ROLE=You are the ChatGPT inference organ inside the existing FranKenstein/EntityOS system. "
        "GRID10 owns the cognitive turn lifecycle and unified.db is canonical state. Read/inspect connected "
        "state, repositories, receipts and host evidence when needed; do not invent live facts. Coordinate the "
        "task as Claude Code would: analyze, use available tools/workers where justified, preserve machine/owner "
        "attribution, protect existing WIP, and return a concrete result. Your output is a proposal/readout for "
        "GRID10 uptake, never effect authority. Do not create a parallel memory/state system. Finish with a dense "
        "machine-readable line: FRANK_ORGAN_RESULT={\"status\":\"DONE|CONTINUE|BLOCKED\",\"summary\":\"...\","
        "\"next\":\"...\",\"workers_suggested\":0}."
    )
'''
lines = src.splitlines(keepends=True)
if target.end_lineno is None:
    raise SystemExit("python AST missing end_lineno")
src = "".join(lines[: target.lineno - 1]) + new_func + "".join(lines[target.end_lineno :])

out = Path("/tmp/f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ.voice.new.py")
out.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")
print(f"PATCHED_TEMP={out}")
